content.summary: A critical flaw in Apache HTTP Server's HTTP/2 module, mod_http2, can let a remote attacker run code on the server. Tracked as CVE-2026-119618, it affects versions 2.4.55 through 2.4.70 and is fixed in version 2.4.71, released yesterday. Only servers with HTTP/2 enabled are affected, according to Red Hat, which ships the server as part of Red Hat Enterprise Linux. An attacker who can reach the...
content.impact: The implications of this cybersecurity update are significant for digital infrastructure in Tier-1 nations. Experts suggest that such developments could influence both consumer behavior and enterprise-level security protocols in the US, UK, CA, and AU markets.
